CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does giving with the ball mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bending the arms as the ball arrives to soften the catch
   B. Throwing the ball away
   C. Handing the ball to the umpire
   D. Kicking the ball

2. Call and response in a folk song means (1 mark)
   A. two drums only
   B. a single hum
   C. a soloist leads and the group answers
   D. everyone is silent

3. In art, tone or value means (1 mark)
   A. how light or dark something is
   B. how big it is
   C. how old it is
   D. how loud it is

4. When sprinting, where should your eyes look? (1 mark)
   A. Behind you
   B. At your feet
   C. Straight ahead
   D. At the sky

5. In the sit-and-slide entry, you first (1 mark)
   A. sit on the edge with feet in the water
   B. jump
   C. dive
   D. run

6. Which is good etiquette for a performer? (1 mark)
   A. Turn your back
   B. Talk during the song
   C. Push others
   D. Walk on and off the stage quietly

7. What do you add to a colour to make it darker? (1 mark)
   A. White
   B. Yellow
   C. Water only
   D. Black

8. What is patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Love for one's country
   B. A kind of race
   C. Fear of runners
   D. Love of food

9. What is the job of the hollow shell of a drum? (1 mark)
   A. To hold the beater
   B. To tie the ropes
   C. To make the sound fuller and louder
   D. To keep the skin wet

10. A monotone line in music writing is (1 mark)
   A. a very loud note
   B. a colour
   C. a single line on which notes are written
   D. a five-line staff

11. A sacred song is (1 mark)
   A. a song of worship
   B. a song with no words
   C. a song about a football match
   D. a work song only

12. Red mixed with yellow makes (1 mark)
   A. orange
   B. purple
   C. green
   D. brown

13. Before joining a coil to a slab you should (1 mark)
   A. cover with oil
   B. dry them in the sun
   C. paint them
   D. scratch both and dab a little water

14. How should we treat the national flag? (1 mark)
   A. Use it as a rag
   B. Write on it
   C. Throw it around
   D. With care and respect, never letting it touch the ground

15. Which twigs are best for making charcoal sticks? (1 mark)
   A. Wet, bent branches
   B. Dry, straight twigs about as thick as a pencil
   C. Thick logs
   D. Green leaves

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What is a rest in music? (2 marks)

17. Describe the procedure of making charcoal sticks for drawing, from cutting to cooling. (5 marks)

18. Explain the difference between the prone float and the supine float. (3 marks)

19. Explain why animal games are called indigenous activities. (3 marks)

20. State how many finger holes a descant recorder has in front and where the thumb hole is. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Bending the arms as the ball arrives to soften the catch
   Bending the arms takes the force out of the ball.

2. C — a soloist leads and the group answers
   The soloist calls and the chorus answers.

3. A — how light or dark something is
   Tone is the lightness or darkness of a colour or shading.

4. C — Straight ahead
   Keeping the head up and eyes ahead helps balance and speed.

5. A — sit on the edge with feet in the water
   You sit, turn and slide in.

6. D — Walk on and off the stage quietly
   Good manners show respect for the audience and others.

7. D — Black
   Black makes a shade, a darker tone.

8. A — Love for one's country
   Patriotism is love and respect for one's country.

9. C — To make the sound fuller and louder
   The air inside the hollow body makes the sound louder.

10. C — a single line on which notes are written
   On a monotone we write the rhythm on one line.

11. A — a song of worship
   Sacred songs praise God, give thanks or teach faith.

12. A — orange
   Red and yellow together give orange.

13. D — scratch both and dab a little water
   Scratching and wetting help the clay pieces stick.

14. D — With care and respect, never letting it touch the ground
   Respect for the flag means caring for it.

15. B — Dry, straight twigs about as thick as a pencil
   Dry, straight, thin twigs burn evenly into good drawing sticks.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: A sign for silence for a certain length of time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for silence, 1 mark for length of time.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Cut dry, straight twigs about the length of a hand. Trim off bark, knots and leaves. Pack the twigs tightly in a tin and close the lid with a small hole. An adult burns the tin in a fire until the smoke stops. Leave the tin closed to cool completely before opening.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for cutting, trimming, packing, burning by an adult, and cooling.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prone is face down in the water with arms stretched forward. Supine is on the back with the face up and ears in the water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each float, 1 mark for the difference.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: They come from the communities and their environment, need little or no equipment and are learnt by watching and joining in.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Seven finger holes in front and the thumb hole is at the back.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
